notes.title: Demo v1.2 & Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[p]Hi there!

[/p][p]Steam Next Fest is approaching quickly! I'm excited, you're excited, we're all excited![/p][p]If you didn't know, my little game here is participating in this edition of the festival. So, if you like what I do, please consider sharing this game with your friends, writing a little demo review, sharing your thoughts with me, and, most importantly, playing the demo!

[/p][p][i]What's contained:[/i][/p][p]With this update, I seriously improved inventory handling, which is one of the core aspects of the game and should be as good as I can make it be. More than that, many items got some serious polish, some of the areas have changed - some of them quite drastically - and everything is just more polished and fun to use and play.[/p][p]If you have already played the demo, I would recommend [b]starting a new game. [/b]Old save games shouldn't break or create bigger issues, but so much has changed in the past updates, that it's just a better experience!  [/p][p]I hope you'll enjoy it.[/p][p]Cheers,
Bernie[/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.1 & Store Page
notes.content:
Hi there!

Version 1.1 of the Fading Serenades Demo is now live!

[b]Contained are new tasks, new dialogues, improvements audio-visually, and more![/b]
This release aims to fill out the in-game days of the demo a little bit better, including hinting a bit more about the story and the world, slowly getting it to be more and more alive.

There's now also a separate store page for the demo, where you can write a review about the demo specifically, which would help me and the game's visibility a lot!

I plan for one more content- and improvement-related update before the Steam Next Fest in June, which I have a few things on my to-do list still I want to get at - like improving the inventory handling a little bit.

Thrilled to hear what you think about it.
Cheers,
Bernie
